business_summary: Nagase & Co., Ltd. manufactures, imports/exports, and sells chemicals, plastics, electronic materials, cosmetics, and health foods worldwide. It offers resin raw materials, monomers, resins, solvents, pigments, dyes, dispersing materials, additives, urethane raw materials, flame retardants, release agents, conductive materials, functional sheets, films, adhesives, and sanitary materials. The company also provides petrochemical products, metal processing oil, surfactants and related raw materials, environmental equipment and chemicals, electronic chemicals, UV-curing agent materials, and chemical outsourcing coordination services. In addition, it offers engineering, general-purpose, packaging, and other plastic-related products and services; precision abrasive materials, optical materials, touch-panel components, functional paints, conductive and insulating materials, adhesive and sealing materials, heat-resistant films, optical lenses, chemical management devices, low dielectric materials, LED lighting, sensing devices, IoT modules, optical materials for XR, and semiconductor- and electronic device-related equipment. Further, the company provides modified epoxy resins and related products, photolithography materials for flat panel displays and semiconductors, and materials related to 3D printing; mobility interior and exterior functional parts, including various resins, functional paints, adhesives, lightweight parts, decorative parts, and HMI parts; xEV-related parts, thermal control parts, battery materials, sensors, LiDAR-related parts, and autonomous driving technologies. Additionally, it offers pharmaceuticals, in vitro diagnostics, raw materials for cosmetics and household products, food materials, premixes, agricultural, fisheries, and livestock-related materials, and endotoxin removal services. The company was founded in 1832 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nagase & Co., Ltd.는 전 세계적으로 화학제품, 플라스틱, 전자재료, 화장품, 건강식품을 제조, 수입/수출 및 판매하고 있습니다. 수지원료, 모노머, 수지, 용제, 안료, 염료, 분산재, 첨가제, 우레탄 원료, 난연제, 이형제, 도전재, 기능성 시트, 필름, 접착제, 위생자재 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 석유화학제품, 금속가공유, 계면활성제 및 관련 원재료, 환경장비 및 화학제품, 전자화학제품, UV 경화제 소재, 화학 ​​아웃소싱 코디네이션 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 엔지니어링, 범용, 포장 및 기타 플라스틱 관련 제품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 정밀연마재료, 광학재료, 터치패널 부품, 기능성 도료, 전도성 및 절연재료, 접착 및 밀봉재료, 내열필름, 광학렌즈, 화학물질 관리장치, 저유전재료, LED 조명, 센싱장치, IoT 모듈, XR용 광학재료, 반도체 및 전자소자 관련 장비. 또한, 회사는 변성 에폭시 수지 및 관련 제품을 제공합니다.
